title: Dahyabhai Chhaganbhai Thakkar v. State of Gujarat

content.caseIdentity: Dahyabhai Chhaganbhai Thakkar v. State of Gujarat, AIR 1964 SC 1563
content.holding: Deconstructed the burden of proof when the accused pleads insanity or general exceptions: the prosecution legal burden never shifts, but the accused satisfies Section 108 BSA by establishing a preponderance of probabilities or raising a reasonable doubt as to mens rea.
content.relevance: Foundational authority on the differential standards of proof for prosecution vs defence under BSA Chapter VII.
